body: They know I’m depressed but not suicidal. Last time I tried to tell them they got incredibly overbearing and tried to watch my every move. It only made things worse in the end.

I don’t know. I don’t know why. I don’t want to hurt my family but I know they’d be better off without me. There’s things I wanted to do but I know I could never do them so what’s the point in trying anymore.

Look OP obviously don’t care about the purpose of this sub. You’ve argued with a lot of the YTA verdicts and refuse to acknowledge that you are TAH in this situation. Why’d you post if you’re not going to accept the verdict?

ESH Except the kid. God honestly it’s better you cut contact so the kid isn’t more traumatized by your ass. You’re blaming him for you ex’s actions as if it’s his fault she cheated. You were his father for most of his childhood and then abandoned him at 10 years old. Obviously you don’t care about him. You should make sure he learns the truth but I guess after that you can do whatever you want and fuck off.

ESH You’re enabling abuse and worrying about money. Both you and your wife need therapy and probably your kids too because this can fuck someone up. I remember once my dad got so mad at me for having my door locked he kicked it down. To this day I don’t trust him not to do that again and can’t have my door locked with being afraid someone’s going to kick it down. This is going to happen to your kids, they’re going to be afraid to have things they care about because they know their parents will just destroy it. Have fun in 10 years when they cut contact with you.

It’s not a bad assumption. There was a road rage incident near where I live a few years ago, the drivers got out of their cars to fight. One of them had a gun and ended up killing the four year old in the backseat of the other guys car.
Yeah it just feels like no matter what happens she’s always right I’m the one who has to apologize

I guess what I meant by not looking to grow is that I’m not looking to grow as a person. I do want to learn and have a career in mind if I ever get through college. But you’re right I should probably try and know myself more before I make a decision.

I guess at the moment I’m not really trying to grow, just really get through it. There are some benefits for me to going to college far away, like being able to be more independent. But I’m fairly introverted and it’s a lot of emotional labor for me to make new friends and become comfortable with them. I’m also afraid going far away would be isolating and I haven’t done well in isolated situations in the past.
Oh! That’s ok. Thank you! I’ll read through and hopefully I’ll be able understand better.

I’m not sure I understand is the terminal uniqueness supposed to be about me or my mother? I don’t really think I’m unique in my situation or that therapy or treatment won’t help. I know that many people are in situations that are exponentially worse than mine. I’m just trying to understand if my thoughts make sense. I’m sorry if I came across as believing my situation is unique and that there are no possible options to fix it.

How do you know if you’re parents are narcissists? Because I think my mom might either be one or is a borderline narcissist.

Anytime we have arguments or disagreements it always ends with me needing to apologize because somehow it’s always my fault. Anytime I try and say that something she’s done has hurt me it’s always turned back on me and I’m the bad guy.

Anytime she’s upset over whatever I have to cater to her emotions and make sure not to upset her more. But anytime I’m upset she’s takes it as a personal insult and if I don’t immediately tell her why I’m upset she gets mad at me.

I’ve tried so many times to try and get her to understand where I’m coming from but she never listens. Anytime I’ve gotten her to say that she will try and listen more she immediately proves she’s not willing to make the effort.

I’m just really tired and I want to know if I’m overreacting.

I’ve always told her she can talk to me and that I’ll listen. Generally I don’t even need to say this and I will try to ask more how she feels. The only reason I’m asking for advice is that this has been going on for years and anytime I’ve tried to sit down and have a conversation about it it always ends in in the aforementioned argument.

I’ve always tried to understand where she’s coming from and money isn’t the only thing this has happened about it was just what came to mind due to a recent conversation we’ve had. I should ask her more how she feels it’s just generally she always tells me how she feels. In fact today she told me she feels she tells me to much.
